name: Saassy Board

sources.title: Homepage — 'List your SaaS and Get paid': revenue-verified leaderboard competition; $10 one-time entry; 50% of revenue to ShareTheMeal charity, 30% to monthly top-3 founders; currently 37 projects, $251 paid out

requirements: A SaaS product you can 'connect' — the leaderboard ranks monthly revenue, so verifiable revenue data is the core mechanic
Founder identity — entries link SaaS to founder name/X handle
preparation: Revenue data connection details (how revenue is verified is not shown on public pages — expect Stripe/LemonSqueezy-style read access or manual verification)
X/Twitter handle for the Sunday mentions and leaderboard display
workflow: Open saassy-board.com and click 'Start Earning Now' / join
Revenue growth earns points each month; top-3 monthly scorers win cash (13%/10%/7% of pool), leaderboard is public
watchFor: Requires sharing revenue data — a real privacy/disclosure decision, not just a listing
Tiny board (37 projects) — the $10 buys leaderboard visibility in a very small pond; ~500 monthly visitors claimed
Prize pool math is modest — 'earn $6.50 for first place' was advertised at research time; payouts scale with platform revenue
Public revenue numbers persist on the leaderboard — competitors can see your MRR
Early-stage side project by two makers; polished but small
countsAsLive: The SaaS appears on the public leaderboard at saassy-board.com with its name, founder, and monthly revenue
unknowns: How revenue verification/connect actually works (no public docs found)
Whether a $0-revenue product can list and still get the backlink
